questions.question: What is Relaxed QWERTY?
questions.answer: Relaxed QWERTY is a free typing trainer that teaches the Relaxed QWERTY 1.0 method on an ordinary QWERTY keyboard: accuracy first, speed as a consequence.

questions.question: What is the Relaxed QWERTY typing method?
questions.answer: Relaxed QWERTY keeps the standard QWERTY map and a stable finger-to-key relationship, but lets the hands move naturally instead of holding the rigid historical home-row posture — the bottom row in particular is reassigned (Z ring, X middle, C index, B right index).

questions.question: Where does Relaxed QWERTY store my progress?
questions.answer: Relaxed QWERTY stores your progress in your account; an account is free and needed to keep progress — without one, nothing is saved past the tab.

questions.question: Who makes Relaxed QWERTY?
questions.answer: Relaxed QWERTY is made by Strange Systems, the studio behind CropASAP and No Ceremony.
